name: Auto podcast import
author: systemsrtk

sections.description:
=Auto Podcast Import – The Easiest Way to Bring Podcasts into WordPress=
Have you ever wanted to automatically import podcast episodes into your WordPress site without jumping through hoops? If so, you’re in the right place.

Auto Podcast Import is a simple, powerful plugin that helps you publish podcast episodes on your website—without the manual work. Whether you’re a podcaster, blogger, or editor, this tool takes care of the repetitive stuff so you can focus on creating content.

What is Auto Podcast Import?

Auto Podcast Import is a WordPress plugin that lets you bring podcast episodes straight into your site using an RSS feed. Once it’s set up, it takes care of everything for you—automatically importing new episodes and publishing them as regular posts or custom post types.
You don’t need to upload audio files manually, create new posts, or copy-paste show notes. It just works. And because it’s designed to be lightweight, it won’t slow down your website.

Key Features

Flexible Scheduling, You can set import schedules to match your release cycle—daily, weekly, monthly, or whenever works best for you. New episodes will show up on your site automatically.

Multiple Feeds, One Site

Import episodes from different podcast feeds and have them all appear on a single WordPress site. Perfect if you’re running more than one show or curating podcasts from various sources.

Custom Post Type Support

Already using a custom post type for your podcast? No problem. The plugin works with your existing setup and gives you full control over how your content appears.

Taxonomy and Organization

You can set specific taxonomies for each feed, helping you organize and display your episodes however you want.

Compatible with All the Big Platforms

The plugin works with popular podcast hosting platforms like Libsyn, BuzzSprout, Transistor, Podbean, Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and SimpleCast. And if your provider isn’t on the list, the support team is open to adding it.

How to Get Started

Getting started is quick and easy:
– Go to your WordPress dashboard, click on “Tools,” then “Auto Podcast Import.”
– Start a new import and set your preferences.
– If you want the episodes to keep coming in automatically, just check the box for continuous sync.
– Click import—and that’s it. You’re all set.
– Need to stop an import later? Just delete it from the list.

Why Use Auto Podcast Import?

There are plenty of reasons to give this plugin a try:
– It saves you time. No more copying and pasting or uploading each episode by hand.
– It improves your SEO. Episodes are added as posts, which means better visibility in search engines.
– It works with your favorite platforms. You don’t have to switch providers or change how you publish.
– It’s simple. You don’t need to be a developer to use it.

If you’re a podcaster or a content creator looking to simplify your workflow, Auto Podcast Import is the tool for you. It’s reliable, easy to use, and totally free. Most importantly, it helps you spend less time managing your podcast—and more time creating it.
Download the plugin today and see how much easier podcasting can be with WordPress.

We are open mind, and think out of the box.
Challenge us.
